answer: Quadratic voting with identity staking: each identity must lock 2500 POA for 90 days before voting. Vote weight = sqrt(credits spent). Attacker creating N fake identities pays N × 2500 POA locked capital, cost growing linearly with N. System verifies via on-chain stake registry and timestamp checks; slashing 10% if duplicate identities detected via zk-proof of unique personhood. The 90% consensus threshold ensures coordinated attacks require 100x honest capital. Words: tundra, oasis, comet.
